user: Give me reason code for transaction TX-0401 with amount 240.00 EUR.
answer:
I couldn't find a reason code recorded on TX-0401. The transaction record shows:

- **Transaction:** TX-0401
- **Amount:** 240.00 EUR
- **Date:** 2026-07-20
- **Merchant:** TechMart Online
- **Type:** card, outbound, settled

Reason codes are used when opening a dispute, so the right one depends on what went wrong. The options are:

- **duplicate_charge** (60-day window): you were charged more than once for the same purchase. TX-0402 is also 240.00 EUR to TechMart Online, dated 2026-07-14, so this may apply if both charges are for the same order.
- **unauthorized_debit** (56-day window): you did not authorize the payment.
- **fraud_card_not_present** (120-day window): a card payment was made fraudulently without your card being present.
- **goods_not_received** (90-day window): you paid but did not receive the item.
- **service_not_rendered** (90-day window): you paid for a service that was not provided.

Windows run from the transaction date. Some may already have closed, so I'll check eligibility before anything is filed.

What happened with this payment? If it's a duplicate charge, I can check TX-0401 against TX-0402 and start the dispute process for you.

Payment dispute rules
## Reason codes and chargeback windows
Each reason code has a window in days from the transaction date. A dispute opened after the window closes is not eligible.

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |

Dispute handling process
## Review timelines
The review target is 10 business days for card reason codes and 20 business
days for transfer reason codes. Complex cases involving a foreign acquirer may
run to 45 calendar days; the customer is notified when that happens.

Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.

Notifications
## Dispute updates
A dispute generates a notification on every state change. The notification
names the state, never the internal reason for a decision.
